description:
## Goal

Derive the one final InputDemand(F) answer directly from source-owned LoweredBody, EntryDispatch, exact protocol/provider facts, and peer InputDemand values. Activation identity is the resulting canonical observation class, not an input arrow plus an auxiliary discriminator.

## Output contract

InputDemand retains normalized typed semantic questions with ordered operand bindings. Questions include dispatch predicates, equality/order, executable type membership, shape/content, returned denotation, and callable identity. Local and acyclic transport is exact. Recursive approximation, if unavoidable, is explicit, sound, finite, and measured.

Do not preselect a DFA, powerset query engine, or other representation in the ticket. Begin with paper examples and prove the smallest final-consumer-owned algebra. Any automaton/index must be unavoidable, bounded, shared, consumed in this commit, and cheaper than the implementation it removes.

## Authorities

- LoweredBody remains the sole operation/value/control denotation. Borrowed owner-qualified refs or indexes may locate existing data but copy no meaning.
- EntryDispatch, StaticCallees and protocol/provider facts remain separate only at their real dependency boundaries.
- ActivationInputs is the sole exact correlated input-row authority.
- Root and caller discovery publish exact rows from their real owners. Delete SeedActivation key-to-row reconstruction and the historical RootSlot activation-key set used to guard it.
- Typed comparisons use the World-owned memo keyed by operation and interned immutable operands. No display string or raw Ty order is identity.
- Every InputDemand dimension publishes atomically. A formula may read peer values but never waits on cyclic peer finality. Generic grounded support from fz-kdt.213 retracts unsupported cycles through the ordinary scheduler.

## Required semantic laws

Preserve direct, delivered, projected, reconstructed, tuple/list/map/bitstring, protocol and callable-identity observations; coherent control-edge tuples; repeated-versus-distinct operand identity; same-callee callsite isolation; discarded delivery; explicit success/failure/Halt; exact map key identity; and conservative recursive soundness.

Independent local or base-return dependence survives a self or mutual recursive edge that passes a constant or rebuilt argument. Exact empty/local bindings contribute no dependency at their own edge. Never weaken a semantic may-dependency with a function-wide recursion-supplied subtraction, fixpoint or cost-policy exemption; equal-result sharing belongs to retained values and products.

Root rekeying, temporary keying withdrawal, self-recursive copublishers, latent-owner evidence withdrawal and no-resurrection behavior remain exact. Removing an evidence owner withdraws only its row; no historical activation key may recreate it.

fz-kdt.188 must first remove blended Cartesian ActivationInputRows. fz-kdt.213 supplies generic grounded retraction. fz-kdt.46 and fz-tfn.6 supply exact producer and activation-appearance edges. fz-tfn.57 supplies exact source replacement ownership.

## TDD

Prove direct, delivered, projected and reconstructed argument/result flow; protocols; maps, lists, tuples and bitstrings; same-callee callsite isolation; repeated versus distinct operands; root rekeying; temporary keying withdrawal; self-recursive copublishers; exact latent-owner withdrawal; no resurrection; explicit success/failure/Halt; independent base returns beside constant or rebuilt recursive arguments; self and mutual recursion without peer-finality waits; grounded cycle removal; equal reproduction; and FIFO/LIFO/permuted admission.

Retain the documented quicksort and enum take/drop comparisons against the pre-fz-kdt.214 causal baseline. Both named lenses must preserve semantic answers while total exact semantic/product work falls below their baseline; an aggregate reduction elsewhere cannot substitute for either lens.

## Required deletion

Delete InputFlow types, producer/store, alias closure, lineage expansion and relation-only tests; the private InputDemand cone/SCC/query solver; every function-wide returned-supply subtraction/fixpoint and cost-policy exemption; Whole/coarse structural demand; BodyKeying::consumes_callable_identity; key-derived evidence; RootSlot historical activation keys; SeedActivation reconstruction; compatibility bridges, transition telemetry, probes and stale docs.

## Signal and acceptance

Cold, unchanged, unrelated edit, relevant edit, recursive ground removal, callsite isolation and three-door production fixtures prove exact semantic answers. Equal answers retain allocation/generation and wake nobody. Total deterministic semantic/product work is lower than the pre-fz-kdt.214 baseline on both named causal lenses; no improvement may discard a real may-dependency. No per-question product traversal, peer-finality wait or global graph rescan survives.

This ticket absorbs the valid acceptance laws of fz-kdt.214, fz-kdt.220, fz-kdt.75 and fz-kdt.165, plus the InputDemand-specific cutover formerly described by fz-kdt.213.
